Parses gossip messages, CRDS values, pull requests, prune, ping, and pong payloads.

# Purpose
This C file implements the parser for gossip protocol messages. It reads a raw network payload and decodes it into `fd_gossip_view_t` and related CRDS view structures. The main entry point is [`fd_gossip_msg_parse`](<#fd_gossip_msg_parse>), which reads the message tag, selects the correct parser, and then validates that the full payload was consumed. The file handles the main gossip message types, including `PULL_REQUEST`, `PULL_RESPONSE`, `PUSH`, `PRUNE`, `PING`, and `PONG`.

The file also contains parsers for many CRDS value types, such as `CONTACT_INFO`, `VOTE`, `LOWEST_SLOT`, `EPOCH_SLOTS`, `VERSION`, `NODE_INSTANCE`, `DUPLICATE_SHRED`, and snapshot hash records. These parsers do not only read fields. They also check size limits, field ranges, duplicate entries, and other format rules before they store offsets and decoded values in the view structures. Helper functions support compact `u16` decoding, varint decoding, bit vector decoding, and validation of contact info addresses and socket tags.
